💡 COUNTER LEARNED — a moth the size of a dinner plate, catching light wrong: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — something huge, rooting in the underbrush: Step OFF the lane. When it lowers its head, step OFF the lane — sideways, not back. It can't turn and it never goes around. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Mountain Lord: Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Inspiration: Be three tiles out. The bloom is the timer: two beats of brightening, then white. Be three tiles out when it flares. The ember beat after is safe — walk in and finish it while it glows itself out. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Speedbump: Never stand next to it. Don't step next to it — it can't chase, so just walk around. Keep two squares away and it's furniture. When it seals up, wait it out. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Understudy: Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big-Eyes: Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sweeps Week: Never show it your back. FACE IT — or paint eyes on the back of your head — and it hesitates. It wants the ambush, not the fight. Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Murkcap: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Heckler: WAIT to answer back. SHAME is the damage, not the swing — WAIT to answer back and clear it before the HEADLINER pile-on. The words demand a response. Give them one, on your terms. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Lockpick: Buy it off. It steals FIRST and fights second — but it CANNOT resist food. OFFER FOOD in the fight: it drops your things mid-scamper for the meal. A bribe is cheaper than a chase. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
